parsed.note_claim: Viral videos claiming to show the Bee Gees' grandchildren singing actually feature Australian singer Ky Baldwin, who is not related to the group.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: However, the video didn't show the Bee Gees' grandchildren singing "How Deep Is Your Love." Rather, it was a cover recording of the song by Ky Baldwin, a singer and actor from Australia.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that the viral video features Ky Baldwin, an Australian singer, and that he stated he is not related to the Bee Gees.
